evals.prompt: 审计 Scholium 的哲学论文分析提示，重点检查来源忠实性、权限和持久化边界；先不要修改产品代码。
evals.expected_output: Selects the philosophy-facing design method and returns a bounded audit grounded in Scholium's live authorities.
assertions: Separates philosophical method quality from technical completion.
Preserves the requested read-only product-code boundary and researcher authority.

evals.prompt: 修复 Scholium 侧栏的 SwiftUI 布局和焦点错误；不要改任何哲学提示或工作流。
evals.expected_output: Routes the task to the native-interface owner without selecting philosophical prompt design; adds engineering only for an actual cross-layer change.
assertions: Recognizes that the requested outcome is technical rather than philosophy-facing method design.
Does not broaden the task into prompt or skill architecture work.

evals.prompt: 设计一个精简的论文分析提示词，区分原文与我们补出的论证；可能只有摘录，分析后可建议主题但不要修改笔记。
evals.expected_output: Produce a reusable prompt with partial-source and candidate-only boundaries.
assertions: Does not attribute reconstructed or repaired claims to the source.
Does not invent missing source details or grant note-edit permission.
Keeps topic suggestions provisional and avoids mandatory full-workflow scaffolding.

evals.prompt: 只把这个哲学分析提示词中的错字改正，不改方法。
evals.expected_output: Make the narrow wording correction without reopening the whole method.
assertions: Loads the target and necessary context, not every methodological reference.
Preserves evidence, permission, method, and output semantics.

evals.prompt: Audit and rewrite this linking instruction for the supplied host contract. Instruction: Every Wikilink asserts a scholarly relation; require evidence before adding any link, classify its argumentative type, then write the inverse into the destination note. Host contract: ordinary Wikilinks are directed authored occurrences; an optional source Markdown annotation belongs to that occurrence; Incoming is a derived read-only projection; links and paths are retrieval aids. Remain read-only and return only the corrected reusable instruction with a brief reason.
evals.expected_output: Allows neutral navigation while requiring evidence for an asserted scholarly relation and preserves source-owned occurrence semantics.
assertions: Does not turn ordinary navigation into an evidential assertion or require proof of support for every link.
Does not invent relationship types, inverse writes, or destination mutations.
Requires available source support before attributing a stronger philosophical relation.

evals.prompt: Design one researcher-owned paper-analysis Skill for an Agent runtime connected to Scholium. It should provide a complete project-neutral analysis method and keep exact source claims distinct from reconstruction. Do not change the Core Protocol, application code, product specification, or any research note. Return the proposed package contract only.
evals.expected_output: Designs the requested optional methodological Skill without prescribing an application-managed method library or expanding effects.
assertions: Permits a complete researcher-owned method without confusing it with the thin Core Protocol.
Preserves source fidelity, partial-access disclosure and researcher-controlled note writes.
Does not invent Research Status fields, managed profiles, official Workflow registration, or application changes.
